items.html: *For this wisdom was engraved and brought forth, etc.; the engraving means that He made for it a receptacle in the manner of male and female, and He brought forth Bina, which is Ima, and it is the river that goes out of Eden to water the garden. And know that ZA is Tifferet Yisrael, and it is the son of YAH, and it was emanated from the coupling of Hochma and Bina, and after its emanation these brains were made for it.
